what: peak and Toffolis for the reference build and for the build with `_update_flag` substituted, at one fixed EEA window
window_note: peak and Toffolis depend on n_iters (the halting counter widens with it), so 1,888 here is this window, not the full-shot 1,893
finding: one body is not enough to move the peak: the register is still allocated for the four bodies that read it, so the build stays at the reference peak and the 1,885 stay accounting
conclusion: the substituted body costs Toffolis and buys no qubits: the register is still allocated for the four bodies that read it, so 1,885 stays an accounting figure
